title: analytics_rules
description: Evaluates intrusion, line-crossing, loitering and fall rules against tracked detections and pose events and publishes analytics events.

rules.description: Rules to evaluate; rules with an unknown type or missing geometry are skipped.

items.description: One rule. Which keys apply depends on type.

name.description: Rule name reported in the rule field of events (all types).

polygon.description: Zone as at least three [x, y] points in frame pixels; required for intrusion and loiter, optional for fall.

line.description: Tripwire as two [x, y] points; required for linecross.

direction.description: Crossing direction that fires a linecross rule, relative to the line drawn from its first to its second point.

seconds.description: Dwell time before a loiter rule fires (default 0), or time a person must stay down before a fall rule fires (default 2.0).

classes.description: Detection labels the rule applies to; empty or absent means all.

stream_id.description: Only evaluate events from this stream; absent means all streams (all types).

tilt_deg.description: Torso angle from vertical, in degrees, that counts as tilted (fall).

aspect.description: Box width-to-height ratio at or above which the body counts as wide (fall).

min_signals.description: How many of the tilt, wide-box and head-low signals must agree for a person to count as down (fall).

keypoint_conf.description: Keypoint confidence needed to use a keypoint (fall).

max_drift.description: Movement allowed while down, in box heights, before the timer restarts (fall).

require_upright.description: Only fire if the person was seen upright within upright_window_sec before going down (fall).

upright_window_sec.description: How recently the person must have been upright when require_upright is set (fall).
